description:
* Provide L2/L3 production support for banking applications, including monitoring, troubleshooting, incident handling, and issue resolution.
* Investigate application issues using logs, error messages, system flows, SQL/data analysis, and available technical documentation.
* Perform or support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring or high-severity incidents.
* Coordinate with Development, Infrastructure, Database, Security teams, and external vendors to investigate and resolve issues.
* Participate in technical calls with vendors to understand system behavior, identify missing information, and follow up on solutions.
* Support application releases, deployments, patches, and production changes following Bank policies and approval procedures.
* Maintain and update SOPs, troubleshooting guides, system flows, incident records, and technical documentation.
* Monitor recurring issues and recommend improvements to application stability and support processes.
requirements_text:
* 5+ years of experience in Application Support, Production Support, Software Support, Technical Support, or similar technical roles.
* Experience supporting business-critical applications; Banking/Fintech experience is preferred.
* Strong MS SQL / SQL skills for data investigation and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of application architecture, APIs/Web Services, system integration, and data flows.
* Working knowledge of .NET/C# applications ; familiarity with Angular, JavaScript, jQuery, or related technologies is a plus.
* Understanding of SDLC, Incident Management, Problem Management, and Change Management.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a structured approach to unfamiliar systems.
* Good English communication skills for working with regional teams and vendors.
* Comfortable working in a strict, process-driven banking environment, including security policies, approval workflows, documentation, and controlled production changes.
